title: Custom named styles xlsx 001
notes: two real openpyxl NamedStyle definitions registered on the workbook: 'GP Money' with a currency number_format ("$"#,##0.00) applied to the B2:D3 numeric range, and 'GP Head' (bold ink-vs-paper font + solid 101A2E fill) applied to the A1:D1 header row; wb.named_styles contains both (asserted), and after save both style names are asserted present in xl/styles.xml. Reference text lists the raw stored values, not the currency-formatted rendering.
